2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Jagarnathpur P.S. Case No. 351 of 2025, registered under section 85 of BNS, 2023, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate,
Ist Class, Ranchi.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits petitioner happens to be husband of the informant and earlier also the informant has filed case under section 498A of I.P.C. against the petitioner in which the case was mediated and on the basis of compromise the informant was residing with the petitioner and after some time second F.I.R has been filed for the same allegation.
He next submits that there is general and omnibus allegation of torture.
On these grounds, he submits that the petitioner may kindly be provided privilege of anticipatory bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer and submits that petitioner happens to be husband of the informant.

5. In view of above and considering that petitioner happens to be husband of the informant and earlier case filed by the informant has been mediated and the informant was residing with the petitioner and after some time second F.I.R has been filed for the same allegation and there is general ( 2025:JHHC:38487 ) and omnibus allegation and view of the matter, petitioner is directed Jayant Munda vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ... ... on 22 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174816696/
